item.title: Endangered person advisory issued for missing 14-year-old girl
item.description: The Saint Louis County Police Department has issued an endangered person advisory for a 14-year-old girl who was last seen Monday evening in north St. Louis County.

item.title: Chickenpox cases confirmed at Principia School in St. Louis County
item.description: Multiple chickenpox cases has been confirmed at Principia School in St. Louis County, and there are possibly up to nine, according to school officials.

item.title: Northwoods cops on trial in beating case where man found abandoned in field
item.description: Two former Northwoods police officers are now on trial, accused of kidnapping a man suspected of shoplifting and leaving him beaten in a field.

item.title: Major Case Squad activated in Carlyle, Illinois over woman's death
item.description: The Major Case Squad of Greater St. Louis has been activated for an investigation into a woman's death Tuesday in Carlyle, Illinois.

item.title: Crestwood teen faces first-degree assault charges after attacks
item.description: A Crestwood, Missouri, teenager will appear in court Wednesday for a pair of violent assaults resulting in broken bones and brain injuries.

item.title: Veteran organization seeks new space after impending closure
item.description: Officials with the Quad Cities DAV (Disabled American Veterans) - Chapter 53 revealed this week that they will be leaving their 5,000 square foot building at the end of the month.

item.title: Farmington man killed in St. Francois County crash
item.description: A 35-year-old Farmington man was killed Tuesday afternoon in a two-vehicle crash.

item.title: Man charged with committing child sex crimes at Kirkwood Walmart
item.description: St. Louis County prosecutors have charged a local man with a disturbing crime. 33-year-old Esmin Pasic of St. Louis is charged with two felony counts related to child sex crimes after several alleged incidents Sunday at a local Walmart.

item.title: Families question deaths at Potosi prison
item.description: The Missouri Department of Corrections is releasing few details about a series of recent deaths at the Potosi Correctional Center as it awaits official autopsy results, but families say the trend is alarming.

item.title: Gas leak leads to home explosion in Jefferson County
item.description: First responders raced to a home explosion Tuesday afternoon just outside Arnold, Missouri.
